Internal helper: a free-text slot typed without its quotes

Source: R/checks.R
dot-jst_free_text_arg.Rd

Ruling R18 (Session 356): a file name, a sheet name, a folder, the name a loaded data frame is given, all go in quotes. A bare symbol in such a slot that resolves to nothing – jload("f.rds", name = mydata), joptions(data.dir = Data) – met R's "object 'Data' not found"; it gets jload()'s form, the call as typed with the word quoted. A symbol that resolves is a name holding the value and is left alone, as is any other expression. The check reads the unevaluated argument, so it runs before the slot is forced.

Usage

.jst_free_text_arg(sub, env, cl, mc, arg, noun, fn)

Arguments

sub

The argument as typed (substitute(arg)).

env

The caller's environment.

cl, mc

The call as typed and the matched call.

arg

Character(1); the argument's name.

noun

Character(1); what the slot takes ("a file name").

fn

Character(1); the user-facing function's name.

Value

Invisible NULL; stops on a bare word that resolves to nothing.
